Source: parent proof, steps 3-4 (monotonicity at zeta on the annulus B_{3s}(zeta) minus B_s(zeta), with the empty ball B_s(zeta), and the lower bound via the nearby support point y), with the density inputs turned into explicit hypotheses.

Context only (not used in the argument). In the parent's application mu = V.weight, p = V.tangentProj, omega = unitBallVolume n and c = C_0 delta; hypothesis (6) is item (iii) of the sibling density_monotonicity at the centre zeta with radii s <= 3s, hypothesis (4) is item (ii) at y, and (5) holds because C_0 delta <= 3^-n omega_n/4. The proof below uses only s > 0, omega > 0, the a.e. strong measurability of p, ||p(x)|| <= 1 and hypotheses (1)-(6).

Notation. B := B_{3s}(zeta) (closed ball), A := B minus B_s(zeta) (a measurable set), g(x) := |(x - zeta) - p(x)(x - zeta)|^2, I := integral over B of g dmu, J := integral over A of g(x)/|x - zeta|^(n+2) dmu. All integrals are Bochner integrals.

1. Measurability. The map x -> x - zeta is continuous, and the evaluation (L, v) -> L v is jointly continuous on L(R^(n+l)) x R^(n+l). Hence x -> p(x)(x - zeta), a continuous function of the a.e. strongly measurable p and the continuous x -> x - zeta, is mu-a.e. strongly measurable. Therefore x -> (x - zeta) - p(x)(x - zeta) and its squared norm g are mu-a.e. strongly measurable.
2. Integrability. For x ∈ B, |x - zeta| <= 3s, so |(x - zeta) - p(x)(x - zeta)| <= |x - zeta| + ||p(x)|| |x - zeta| <= 3s + 3s = 6s and 0 <= g(x) <= 36 s^2. A bounded a.e. strongly measurable function is integrable on a set of finite measure; by (2), mu(B) < infinity, so g is mu-integrable on B, and hence on A ⊆ B.
3. Annulus comparison. For x ∈ A, x is not in B_s(zeta), so |x - zeta| > s > 0, hence |x - zeta|^(n+2) >= s^(n+2) > 0 and 0 <= g(x)/|x - zeta|^(n+2) <= (s^(n+2))^(-1) g(x).
   (i) The function (s^(n+2))^(-1) g is integrable on A (step 2) and g/|x - zeta|^(n+2) is nonnegative. For the Bochner integral, a nonnegative function dominated a.e. by an integrable function has integral at most the integral of that function (no integrability of the smaller function is needed). So J <= integral over A of (s^(n+2))^(-1) g dmu = (s^(n+2))^(-1) * integral over A of g dmu.
   (ii) Since g >= 0 is integrable on B ⊇ A, the integral of g over A is at most the integral of g over B, which is I.
   (iii) Hence J <= (s^(n+2))^(-1) I.
4. Mass lower bound. B_s(y) ⊆ B: for x ∈ B_s(y), dist(x, zeta) <= dist(x, y) + dist(y, zeta) <= s + 2s = 3s by (3). By (4) and monotonicity of mu, ENNReal.ofReal(omega s^n/2) <= mu(B_s(y)) <= mu(B), and mu(B) < infinity by (2). Converting to real numbers, omega s^n/2 <= mu(B).toReal.
5. Using (6). By (1), mu(B_s(zeta)).toReal = 0, so the first term on the right of (6) vanishes and (6) reads ((3s)^n)^(-1) mu(B).toReal <= c + e^2 J. Since ((3s)^n)^(-1) (omega s^n/2) = omega/(2 * 3^n) and ((3s)^n)^(-1) > 0, step 4 gives omega/(2 * 3^n) <= ((3s)^n)^(-1) mu(B).toReal. Using step 3(iii) multiplied by e^2 >= 0:
   omega/(2 * 3^n) <= c + e^2 J <= c + e^2 (s^(n+2))^(-1) I.
6. Absorbing c. By (5), c <= omega/(4 * 3^n), and omega/(2 * 3^n) = omega/(4 * 3^n) + omega/(4 * 3^n). So step 5 gives omega/(4 * 3^n) <= e^2 (s^(n+2))^(-1) I. Multiplying both sides by the positive number 4 * 3^n * s^(n+2)/omega gives s^(n+2) <= (4 * 3^n * e^2/omega) * I, which is the claim. QED

theorem lgc_hole_annulus_lower : ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (p : Amb n ℓ → (Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ)) (ζ y : Amb n ℓ) (s ω c : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < ω → AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → (∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ 1) → μ (closedBall ζ s) = 0 → μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s)) ≠ ⊤ → dist y ζ ≤ 2 * s → ENNReal.ofReal (ω * s ^ n / 2) ≤ μ (closedBall y s) → c ≤ ω / (4 * 3 ^ n) → ((3 * s) ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s))).toReal ≤ Real.exp 2 * ((s ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall ζ s)).toReal) + c + Real.exp 2 * ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ closedBall ζ s, ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - ζ‖ ^ (n + 2) ∂μ → s ^ (n + 2) ≤ 4 * 3 ^ n * Real.exp 2 / ω * ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
  intro n ℓ μ p ζ y s ω c hs hω hp hpb hhole hfin hy hlow hc hmono
  have hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2) μ := by
    have h1 : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => p x (x - ζ)) μ :=
      Continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable₂
        (g := fun (L : Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (v : Amb n ℓ) => L v)
        (continuous_fst.clm_apply continuous_snd) hp
        (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).aestronglyMeasurable.sub h1).norm.pow 2)
  have hgb : ∀ x ∈ closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2‖ ≤ 36 * s ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have hxz : ‖x - ζ‖ ≤ 3 * s := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hx
    have h1 : ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ≤ 6 * s := by
      calc ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ≤ ‖x - ζ‖ + ‖p x (x - ζ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖x - ζ‖ + ‖p x‖ * ‖x - ζ‖ := by gcongr; exact (p x).le_opNorm _
        _ ≤ 3 * s + 1 * (3 * s) := by gcongr; exact hpb x
        _ = 6 * s := by ring
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    calc ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (6 * s) ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = 36 * s ^ 2 := by ring
  have hgi : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2) (closedBall ζ (3 * s)) μ :=
    Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hfin hgm
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_closedBall hgb)
  have hAm : MeasurableSet (closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ closedBall ζ s) :=
    measurableSet_closedBall.diff measurableSet_closedBall
  have hpos : 0 < s ^ (n + 2) := by positivity
  have hJ : ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ closedBall ζ s,
        ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - ζ‖ ^ (n + 2) ∂μ ≤
      (s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ * ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    calc ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ closedBall ζ s,
          ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - ζ‖ ^ (n + 2) ∂μ
        ≤ ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ closedBall ζ s,
            (s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ * ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
          apply integral_mono_of_nonneg
          · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by positivity)
          · exact (hgi.mono_set sdiff_subset).const_mul _
          · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hAm] with x hx
            have hxs : s < ‖x - ζ‖ := by
              have := hx.2
              rw [mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm] at this
              exact this
            have hpow : s ^ (n + 2) ≤ ‖x - ζ‖ ^ (n + 2) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs.le hxs.le _

      _ ≤ (s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ * ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
          exact setIntegral_mono_set hgi (Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by positivity))
            (Eventually.of_forall sdiff_subset)
  have hsub : closedBall y s ⊆ closedBall ζ (3 * s) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_closedBall] at hx ⊢
    calc dist x ζ ≤ dist x y + dist y ζ := dist_triangle _ _ _

    calc ω / (2 * 3 ^ n) = ((3 * s) ^ n)⁻¹ * (ω * s ^ n / 2) := h3n.symm
      _ ≤ ((3 * s) ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s))).toReal :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmB (by positivity)
      _ ≤ _ := hmono
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  have hkey : ω / (4 * 3 ^ n) ≤ Real.exp 2 * ((s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ *

    have : ω / (2 * 3 ^ n) = ω / (4 * 3 ^ n) + ω / (4 * 3 ^ n) := by field_simp; ring

  calc s ^ (n + 2) = (4 * 3 ^ n / ω) * (ω / (4 * 3 ^ n)) * s ^ (n + 2) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ (4 * 3 ^ n / ω) * (Real.exp 2 * ((s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ)) * s ^ (n + 2) := by
        gcongr
    _ = 4 * 3 ^ n * Real.exp 2 / ω *
          ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
        field_simp
